page: Amazon Web Services c7g.medium is an arm64-based compute-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 processor. It features 1 physical core and 1 vCPU running at 2.6 GHz, with a cache hierarchy consisting of 64 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. The instance is provisioned with 2.0 GB of memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It operates on the Nitro hypervisor, includes no local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall within the average range, reflecting the capabilities of the Neoverse-V1 core. However, because the instance is limited to a single vCPU, multi-core benchmarks like stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core fall into the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block speeds at 28.44 GB/sec and write large block speeds at 10.44 GB/sec.

This instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for entry-level workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand high memory capacity or multi-threaded execution. It is suitable for lightweight single-threaded tasks, basic text processing, and small-scale web serving. It is not designed for memory-intensive databases, software compilation, or multi-threaded processing due to its 2.0 GB memory limit and single-core configuration.
